observations.family: The enlarged crop shows a closed dark bowl with a right stem: a_i, not n_i. Below the space before the family is a pale V-like trace, one leg diffuse and the other with a short dark segment. Its status as writing or surface trace remains uncertain; retain its geometry with a doubt mark, without assigning punctuation value.
observations.transitivity: Two parallel shafts have a left point and an upper-right bend returning downward as a thick right arrowhead. Main resolves the sign as equivalence, agreeing with R1/R2 and S. The wrapped ending visibly reads un au plus sont / nuls; au plus is ordinary continuation, not an added margin note.
observations.cor_glyph: The large S has a rounded returning body, an inner horizontal bar and a raised right flourish. Decorative S is secure; blackletter versus script remains doubtful. The compressed mod ends in d, with no independent following point.
observations.table_classes: After the initial cl and compressed middle, the ending is a short rounded exit with no securely separable final s. Main retains R2's classes|classe; the plural is primary, not inferred solely from 2.
observations.a_glyph: The A has a doubled tall left part, a heavy flat roof and a curved lower return. Retain blackletter as primary and script as an alternative.
observations.a4: A4 and its colon stand outside the cancellation. The representatives are crossed by a zigzag and partly enclosed by a long open-right curve. Initial 1 has a broad foot, but a nearby point and overlying strokes leave i possible. First index favors 12; second favors 34; last favors 1234, but each initial disputed digit is touched by cancellation. Main retains all four C doubts rather than adopting R2's two resolutions. The final digits project beyond the enclosure.
observations.chain: The first Z has an additional interior stroke, beyond its main diagonal; main resolves double-stroking with R1/R2. All straight links are blunt, while the lower return curve has a left hook/head. The terminal 1 is followed by a closed bowl and descending tail, securely q; its function is not inferred.
observations.identity: The central sequence is visibly qp: a closed q loop and descending tail followed by a taller p stem and right shoulder. Both distant flanking characters are heavily retraced. Keep p|q at left and q|p at right; R1's resolution of the latter is not secure enough in the crop.
observations.hom: The abbreviation has h, low o/m strokes and a detached period, with no second om. The final group word has a long g descender and a compact middle before the p/es ending. Gpes is plausible, but compressed groupes cannot be excluded: retain R3's new whole-word doubt.
observations.inclusion: The second chain has one clear right head, from G to Gamma; the remaining connectors are blunt. Gamma prime is directly below G, separated by a small upward-open inclusion sign. Preserve the vertical arrangement.
observations.second_note: A tall angular Gamma is written over low letters after the isomorphism sign. The canceled underword remains iso|is, and the separate final word also remains iso|is because its terminal loop is filled. H loses the live target and overwrite state.
observations.group_word: After ou à donner the g descender is followed by a short arched shoulder and a separate low ending. Main favors grs, agreeing with R1, but retains gpes because the compressed strokes do not securely settle the contraction. No ou is supplied.
observations.aut: Small gr lies below Aut; g has a long low return, followed by a short r. There is no point in the gap before (Z). Resolve C's gr|gr. doubt.
observations.left: The rotated note gives Parler ici d'un gr, followed by inverseur d'extensions, then car/où cela permet d'introduire and Aff(Z) approximately Z.Aut Z. The tall first word remains doubtful as a word, but lowercase parler is not supported by its size. Gr has no p/e continuation. Inverseur has a final r exit and no separate s: resolve that ending. The compressed connective stays car|où. The final canceled word favors Aut(Z), with AutZ and Aut retained because its crossing and edge position obscure the end. The product point is low on the local baseline. A separate divider stands above this slanted text. Reproduce the left position and the slant, not just a comment about them.
observations.right: The first subgroup word has a longer compressed middle than the second ss-gpe, but individual ou strokes are not secure: keep Ss-groupes|Ss-gpes. The canceled base after de has an upper closed loop and a leg, favoring R over Gamma; no separate live Gamma precedes it. Et on a is present, not et alors. The final Z has an extra interior stroke and its following dot is low. Preserve the long rising separator and its short close companion stroke.
observations.laws: The canceled law has the minus-one outside the closing parenthesis after gamma-prime. Its multiplication point is at the low writing baseline. In the live law, the second-factor z-prime has a rounded upper return unlike the angular first z; retain z-prime|script-Z-prime at this first occurrence, using the primary for the repeated argument. Cancellation remains on the entire upper law only.
observations.cor_layout: The paired elevated ticks around partitions are double quotation marks, not guillemets. The vertical rule begins below the Cor line, alongside the continuation aux partitions and the final sum; it does not run beside the opening Cor line. The sum is on its own left-aligned line immediately right of the rule. Main restores this rule extent as well as the left alignment.
observations.rectification: The crop shows car on ne veut pas de polygone à 1 coté, ds les graphes ! The word is singular polygone and the verb is veut. The final e of coté has an accent; the o has no circumflex. The long underline begins beneath ait and runs through pas de pt fixe.
observations.heading: The contracted heading word shows g followed by a p/es cluster without a written rou/ou sequence. Retain gpes.
observations.donner: The word ends in an r-like exit with no acute over its final e: donner. It shares the baseline of the first 1 and chain, so main adopts R3's adjacent placement.
observations.product: The Z in G=Z times Gamma has clear internal double strokes and a narrow light space within the heavy diagonal. Retain blackboard Z rather than H's plain Z. The following Gamma is strongly retraced but remains angular Gamma.
